plumbing: Complete plumbing = hot and cold piped water, bathtub or shower, flush toilet. Earlier censuses required exclusive use by the unit occupants; dropped in 1990 (Census page).
fuel: 1940: utility gas and bottled gas were combined (shown under utility_gas_pct); electricity was collected but not tabulated.
1950: electricity was tallied only for noncentral heating systems.
water: 1990 all housing units; 1970 and 1980 year-round units only. 1970 drilled/dug split not available.
general: State rows keep percentages only (US rows keep counts); counts for states are in the source text files.
Census page: complete plumbing facilities = hot and cold piped water, a bathtub or shower, and a flush toilet; earlier censuses required exclusive use, dropped in 1990.
Census page: in 1990 only 1 percent of homes lacked complete plumbing; in 1940 nearly half did.
Some count tokens truncated in the source files (e.g. 1940 other units, 2000 5+ units) are null; percentages are intact.
